import json, sys, itertools
names = ['S%d'%i for i in range(16)]
svcs = [{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
LIM = {'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
def big_policy(nwords):
    prefixes = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=4))[:nwords]
    suffixes = list(itertools.product(range(16), repeat=4))[:nwords]
    words = [tuple(list(p)+list(s)) for p,s in zip(prefixes, suffixes)]
    return 'startswith() allow;' + ''.join('match(%s) drop;' % ','.join(names[c] for c in w) for w in words)
events = [{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':big_policy(3000)},
          {'op':'commit','epoch':1},
          {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'S0'},
          {'op':'spawn','unit':[0,2,1],'service':'S1'},
          {'op':'open','connection':[1,1]}]
n = 1
rid = 0
# alternate begin/finish and send/recv plus periodic inspect
for i in range(60000):
    rid += 1
    if i % 3 == 0:
        events.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
        events.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
    elif i % 3 == 1:
        events.append({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
        events.append({'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid,'connection':[1,1],'stream':i+1,'destination':'S1'})
        events.append({'op':'recv','connection':[1,1],'stream':i+1,'unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid,'wire':None})
        events.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,1],'rid':rid})
        events.append({'op':'finish','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})
    else:
        events.append({'op':'inspect'})
sys.stderr.write('job1 events %d\n' % len(events))
print(json.dumps({'jobs':[{'services':svcs,'limits':LIM,'events':events}]}))
PYEOF
